data.body: URGENCY UPDATE (2026-08-15, via dependabot PR #128 — the FOURTH mcp 2.0 re-proposal after #124/#125/#127): mcp v2.0.0 is now the STABLE release; v1.x is in MAINTENANCE MODE receiving security fixes only (upstream release notes, github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk v2.0.0). Staying on mcp>=1.28.1,<2 is therefore time-bounded, and this epic gains urgency. Migration surface confirmed by upstream: FastMCP renamed to MCPServer (decorator API unchanged); one Client object replaces transport+ClientSession+initialize(); protocol types split into the mcp-types package (mcp.types remains a permanent alias); stdout diverted to stderr while serving (affects any stdio assumptions); supports the 2026-07-28 protocol revision while still serving 2025-era clients. Migration guide: py.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/migration/. The #128 safe subset (json-repair/genai-prices/botocore) lands separately under ticket c44a-2d4c-f793-42e6 (paralytic-yester-needletail).
